extension.description: Lightweight LaTeX preview that also works in VSCode for the Web
config.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds before the preview updates after an edit.
config.followActiveEditor: The preview follows the active .tex editor. Use the lock icon at the top right of the preview tab to keep showing a specific file. When false, each file gets its own preview.
config.mathMacros: KaTeX macros available in every document, e.g. `{ "\\R": "\\mathbb{R}" }` (in settings.json). Macros defined in the document with `\newcommand` take precedence.
config.paginate: Split documents with \documentclass into pages of \textheight. When false, the document is shown as one continuous page.
config.scrollSync: Sync scrolling between the editor and the preview.
config.showUnknownCommands: Show unsupported commands as dimmed source text.
